hero.title: Checked pieces, simple ordering, fast delivery.
hero.description: ATLAS CO. sells fashion and accessories for women and men, with Romania and international shipping. Pick the item, message us on WhatsApp, confirm stock, and pay cash on delivery where available.
home.trustAuthenticDesc: We list authentic products and confirm the details before the order is shipped.

home.trustShippingDesc: We ship in Romania by courier and confirm international delivery separately.
home.trustPricingDesc: Payment is made on delivery. No complicated checkout and no advance payment for standard orders.
home.contactDescription: If you need a specific model or want confirmation for size, color, or availability, message me directly.
